description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/ListingCreate/GetDataByPSIds. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Loads current supplier data for the exact product-source variations used during manual multi-variation product creation. ownerAgent: publication. Domain: publication. Entity: product_source_variation_data. Operation: read_and_refresh. Scope: selected_channel. Use when: Use it when the manual product form needs price, stock, EAN and source images for a known set of exact ProductSourceIds, especially before displaying or publishing all supplier variations. Do not use it to discover products or variations without exact ProductSourceIds, or for existing store-listing collection or ranking. Input: [FromBody] rq: GetDataByPSIdsRequest. Main fields: ProductSourceIds: int[]. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Admin: false. Output: Returns ProductSources keyed by the requested ProductSourceId, with available images, price, stock and EAN. Cached stock is read from saved supplier stock options. Matalan and Home Bargains sizes are refreshed with live stock information, including zero stock for unavailable sizes. Sources configured for live refresh return non-empty freshly scraped images immediately; cached images are retained only when the refresh supplies no images. Requested AliExpress variation URLs using a readable selection, a numeric skuId/sku_id, or both together, without a saved supplier SKU are refreshed to resolve that exact variation and load its images. These AliExpress child refreshes obtain stock information and return refreshed data only after the supplier identity, price and available stock have been saved. If the supplier identity, price or available stock cannot be confirmed, or saving fails, the response retains cached data. Bare AliExpress product URLs are not refreshed by this recovery rule. The refresh can also update stored product-source data. Search terms: listingcreate getdatabypsids. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
